tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows support a monotone concave branch but do not identify the gradient dependence. The discriminating probe provides the needed wide s_grad leverage; subsequent fitting should use the full fallback parameter box.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth square-root siphon from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, leaving their individual effects poorly identified.
The immediate ambiguity is gradient leverage, not temporal resolution.
It is irrelevant to identifying the siphon parameters.
